The '''1934 FA Charity Shield''' was the 21st [[FA Community Shield|FA Charity Shield]], a [[Association football|football]] match between the winners of the previous season's [[Football League First Division|First Division]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. The match was contested by league champions [[Arsenal F.C.|Arsenal]] and FA Cup winners [[Manchester City F.C.|Manchester City]], and was played at [[Arsenal Stadium|Highbury]], the home ground of Arsenal. Arsenal won the game, 4–0.<ref>{{Cite web | url = https://www.rsssf.org/tablese/engsupcuphist.html | title = England &ndash; List of FA Charity/Community Shield Matches| website = [[RSSSF]] | access-date= 30 October 2013 }}</ref>
